description: Evaluation record for refresh/t3_acc2.py: the sha256 and problem count of each benchmark parquet, the decontamination of the benchmarks against the DAPO-Math-17k training parquet (method, thresholds, adjudication rule, excluded problems and the adjudication of every flagged problem), and the endpoint. data_dir and decontam.train_file are relative to $CLUSTER_ROOT; the files are checked by sha256, not by path.

decontam.adjudication_rule: exclude if and only if one of the top candidate training rows (top 3 by W, top 3 by S3) asks the same question on the same data, up to the answer's format (k+m of a fraction, remainder mod 100, numerator only, ...); otherwise keep
